display_long_description:
**GATHER YOUR PARTY**

Bring your friends. They'll share potions, watch your back, and, at some point, absolutely leave you to the monsters so they can make it out alive, but hey, you’d do the same for them.

**CHOOSE YOUR HERO**

Go full spellcaster as the Mage, or pick off enemies as the Archer. Prefer close combat? Knight and Brawler have you covered. And if two of you pick the same Hero? That's when things get interesting. Deck yours out in colours, props, and accessories so your party can actually find you in the chaos instead of yelling “wait, which one's you?”

**PASS ON POWER POSES**

Power Poses are basically the world's most useful secret handshake. Strike a pose, get a buff. Teach that pose to your party, and now everyone’s flexing together. In Heroes Together VR, sharing really is caring (and it makes you stronger too).

**FIND THE CRITTERS**

Everyone on the team has a favourite critter and will fight you about it. Meet Dot, Tad, and Kai, then pick a side. They're small. They're cute. They will absolutely distract your party mid-run, and you’ll love them for it.

**UNWIND IN TETHERFALL**

While your local Mage spends twenty minutes finding the perfect hat or your friendly Brawler needs to rest their arms, hit the beach for Uppyball, grab a (virtual) snack at Hero's Nook, or just vibe by the Lagoon.

**BUILD TO PLAY AGAIN**

No two runs through Gobi Gulch play out the same, which means no two runs go wrong the same way either. Play it safe or choose the chaos route for the drama. You’ll still be a Hero to us!
